question: Should explicit release provenance be represented by this commit-message marker or by the typed trusted CLI provenance modes in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103687?
rationale: Both open maintainer-authored branches define authoritative provenance inputs with different operator, audit, and precedence semantics; repository evidence cannot determine which is intended as the permanent contract.

options.title: Use typed CLI provenance
options.body: Retain the issue-linked operator-supplied provenance modes and avoid interpreting ordinary commit bodies as ownership metadata.

options.title: Use commit markers
options.body: Adopt this smaller marker grammar as canonical, document it, and remove or supersede overlapping CLI modes.

options.title: Keep distinct modes
options.body: Define non-overlapping use cases, precedence, and conflict coverage if both authorities are intentionally required.

recommendation.title: Use typed CLI provenance
recommendation.body: Retain the issue-linked operator-supplied provenance modes and avoid interpreting ordinary commit bodies as ownership metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current verifier history, canonical issue, and both competing implementations.
